name: webable
description: Free, open-source browser extension and website widget that adapts the web to the person using it: accessibility tools, a keyboard command bar, click hints, smart page fixes, and an honest site checker.
author: WebAble contributors

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/companion/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/power/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/widget/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node apps/extension/build.mjs && node scripts/test-core.mjs && node apps/widget/build.mjs && node scripts/smoke-bundle.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:extension && node scripts/bundle-gate.mjs && node scripts/a11y-audit.mjs && node scripts/no-em-dash.mjs
